dialogues.speaker: Ikuhara Gai
dialogues.text: Lately, some soldiers came over to tell me that they found some areas nearby from which ore can be mined, and that they even saw some rare Magical Crystal Ores.

dialogues.speaker: Ikuhara Gai
dialogues.text: As for those, well... Magical Crystal Ores are pretty high-quality stuff, alright. But it's hard to make weapons from them, so they're of little use to me.

dialogues.speaker: Ikuhara Gai
dialogues.text: I'd put them as having been around here, and I'll help you mark them out. Go check them out if you're interested.
